title: Controlled finer-mesh sensitivity experiment (h_core = 0.75 um = l0/10) for Method A off-axis-hole plate
scientific_objective: Execute one controlled finer-mesh crack propagation simulation (h_core = 0.75 um = l0/10, 69,903 physical elements, 209,709 layered elements) on cluster mmaster02 to quantify peak load, energy evolution, and crack trajectory sensitivity against the 52,447-element F1645 benchmark
